Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select

Class SelectActionObject

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select.SelectActionObject
public class SelectActionObject extends Object
Data container for configuring and tracking the state of a Select operation.

This class encapsulates all the configuration needed to perform a selection operation, including the swipe parameters, find options, click settings, and optional confirmation verification. It also tracks the operation's results and state during execution.

A SelectActionObject contains:

  • Configuration for swipe operations (from/to locations, action options)
  • Configuration for finding target images
  • Configuration for clicking on found matches
  • Optional configuration for confirmation verification
  • Runtime state tracking (swipe count, matches found, success status)

This class uses the Builder pattern for construction to handle its many configuration parameters. The runtime state fields are modified by the Select class during operation execution.

Migration Note: This class now supports both ActionConfig (legacy) and ActionConfig (modern) APIs. New code should use the ActionConfig setters. The getters intelligently return the appropriate configuration based on which was set.

  • Method Details

    • resetTotalSwipes

      public void resetTotalSwipes()
      Resets the swipe counter to zero.

      This method is typically called at the beginning of a select operation to ensure accurate tracking of swipe attempts.

    • addSwipe

      public void addSwipe()
      Increments the swipe counter by one.

      Called after each swipe operation to track the total number of swipes performed during the selection process.

    • setFoundMatches

      public void setFoundMatches(ActionResult matches)
      Sets the matches found during the find operation.

      This method is called by Select to store the results of each find attempt during the selection process.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing found matches from the find operation

    • setFoundConfirmations

      public void setFoundConfirmations(ActionResult matches)
      Sets the confirmation matches found after clicking.

      This method stores the results of the confirmation find operation, which verifies that the click action had the desired effect.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult containing confirmation matches

    • setSuccess

      public void setSuccess(boolean success)
      Sets the overall success status of the select operation.

      Set to true when the operation completes successfully (target found, clicked, and optionally confirmed). Set to false otherwise.

      Parameters:
      success - true if the operation succeeded, false otherwise
